---
title: "Exploring classification thresholds"
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

This explorer uses the TIT-based high-CO logistic model on the training set.
It follows one decision threshold as it changes the ROC curve, the
precision–recall curve, and F1 score at the same time.

::: {.callout-tip}
## What to watch

Start with a very high threshold: no observations receive a high-CO label. As
the threshold decreases, the model produces more alerts. The ROC curve traces
true-positive against false-positive rate; the precision–recall curve shows
the same alerts from a different perspective. F1 summarizes the balance
between precision and recall.
:::

```{=html}
<div id="threshold-metrics-builder" class="clt-explorer threshold-metrics-builder" aria-label="Interactive classification-threshold explorer">
  <div class="clt-controls threshold-metrics-controls" aria-label="Classification threshold control">
    <label>
      <span>Decision threshold</span>
      <input id="threshold-metrics-slider" type="range" min="0" value="0">
      <output id="threshold-metrics-value" for="threshold-metrics-slider">τ = 1.00</output>
    </label>
  </div>
  <div class="clt-buttons" aria-label="Threshold-sweep controls">
    <button id="threshold-metrics-run" type="button" class="regression-sampling-primary">Run all thresholds</button>
    <button id="threshold-metrics-step" type="button">Next threshold</button>
    <button id="threshold-metrics-reset" type="button">Reset</button>
  </div>
  <p id="threshold-metrics-status" class="clt-status tabular-nums" aria-live="polite"></p>
  <div class="clt-plots threshold-metrics-plots">
    <figure class="clt-plot threshold-metrics-plot">
      <figcaption>Training ROC curve</figcaption>
      <svg id="roc-threshold-chart" role="img" aria-label="Training ROC curve being drawn as the threshold decreases"></svg>
    </figure>
    <figure class="clt-plot threshold-metrics-plot">
      <figcaption>Training precision–recall curve</figcaption>
      <svg id="precision-recall-chart" role="img" aria-label="Training precision-recall curve being drawn as the threshold decreases"></svg>
    </figure>
    <figure class="clt-plot threshold-metrics-plot">
      <figcaption>F1 score by decision threshold</figcaption>
      <svg id="f1-threshold-chart" role="img" aria-label="Training F1 score as the threshold decreases"></svg>
    </figure>
  </div>
</div>
```

The slider lowers $\tau$ in evenly spaced increments from 1 to 0. Each point
uses all observations whose predicted probability is at least $\tau$; the
same set of alerts drives all three views.

<a href="index.qmd">← Return to Classification</a>

<script src="../assets/precision-recall-thresholds.js"></script>
<script>
(() => {
  const root = document.getElementById("threshold-metrics-builder");
  if (!root || !window.MECE4520PrecisionRecallPoints) return;

  const points = window.MECE4520PrecisionRecallPoints;
  const negativeCount = points.at(-1).fp;
  const slider = root.querySelector("#threshold-metrics-slider");
  const thresholdValue = root.querySelector("#threshold-metrics-value");
  const status = root.querySelector("#threshold-metrics-status");
  const rocChart = root.querySelector("#roc-threshold-chart");
  const prChart = root.querySelector("#precision-recall-chart");
  const f1Chart = root.querySelector("#f1-threshold-chart");
  const runButton = root.querySelector("#threshold-metrics-run");
  const stepButton = root.querySelector("#threshold-metrics-step");
  const resetButton = root.querySelector("#threshold-metrics-reset");

  slider.max = String(points.length - 1);

  let pointIndex = 0;
  let running = false;
  let animationFrame = null;
  let lastFrameTime = 0;

  function svgElement(tagName, attributes = {}) {
    const element = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", tagName);
    Object.entries(attributes).forEach(([name, value]) => element.setAttribute(name, value));
    return element;
  }

  function addText(svg, text, x, y, attributes = {}) {
    const element = svgElement("text", { x, y, ...attributes });
    element.textContent = text;
    svg.append(element);
  }

  function scale(value, domain, range) {
    return range[0] + ((value - domain[0]) / (domain[1] - domain[0])) * (range[1] - range[0]);
  }

  function chartSetup(chart, titleText, descriptionText) {
    const width = Math.max(280, Math.round(chart.getBoundingClientRect().width) || 360);
    const compact = width < 480;
    const margin = compact
      ? { top: 16, right: 18, bottom: 50, left: 56 }
      : { top: 20, right: 24, bottom: 58, left: 66 };
    const plotSize = Math.max(1, width - margin.left - margin.right);
    const height = plotSize + margin.top + margin.bottom;
    const plotRight = margin.left + plotSize;
    const plotBottom = margin.top + plotSize;
    const x = value => scale(value, [0, 1], [margin.left, plotRight]);
    const y = value => scale(value, [0, 1], [plotBottom, margin.top]);

    chart.replaceChildren();
    chart.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 " + width + " " + height);
    chart.setAttribute("width", String(width));
    chart.setAttribute("height", String(height));
    chart.setAttribute("preserveAspectRatio", "xMidYMid meet");

    const title = svgElement("title", { id: chart.id + "-title" });
    title.textContent = titleText;
    const description = svgElement("desc", { id: chart.id + "-description" });
    description.textContent = descriptionText;
    chart.append(title, description);
    chart.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", title.id + " " + description.id);

    chart.append(svgElement("rect", {
      x: margin.left, y: margin.top,
      width: plotRight - margin.left, height: plotBottom - margin.top,
      class: "threshold-metrics-frame"
    }));

    [0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1].forEach(tick => {
      const xPosition = x(tick);
      const yPosition = y(tick);
      chart.append(svgElement("line", {
        x1: xPosition, y1: margin.top, x2: xPosition, y2: plotBottom,
        class: "threshold-metrics-grid"
      }));
      chart.append(svgElement("line", {
        x1: margin.left, y1: yPosition, x2: plotRight, y2: yPosition,
        class: "threshold-metrics-grid"
      }));
      addText(chart, tick.toFixed(1), xPosition, plotBottom + 20, {
        class: "threshold-metrics-tick", "text-anchor": "middle"
      });
      addText(chart, tick.toFixed(1), margin.left - 9, yPosition + 4, {
        class: "threshold-metrics-tick", "text-anchor": "end"
      });
    });

    return { height, margin, plotRight, plotBottom, x, y };
  }

  function drawPath(chart, setup, values, xValue, yValue, curveClass, currentX, currentY) {
    const pathData = values.map((point, index) =>
      (index === 0 ? "M" : "L")
      + setup.x(xValue(point)).toFixed(2) + " " + setup.y(yValue(point)).toFixed(2)
    ).join(" ");
    chart.append(svgElement("path", { d: pathData, class: curveClass }));
    chart.append(svgElement("circle", {
      cx: setup.x(currentX), cy: setup.y(currentY), r: 5.5,
      class: "threshold-metrics-current"
    }));
  }

  function addAxes(chart, setup, xTitle, yTitle) {
    addText(chart, xTitle, (setup.margin.left + setup.plotRight) / 2, setup.height - 11, {
      class: "threshold-metrics-axis-title", "text-anchor": "middle"
    });
    const yTitleX = 18;
    const yTitleY = (setup.margin.top + setup.plotBottom) / 2;
    addText(chart, yTitle, yTitleX, yTitleY, {
      class: "threshold-metrics-axis-title", "text-anchor": "middle",
      transform: "rotate(-90 " + yTitleX + " " + yTitleY + ")"
    });
  }

  function drawRoc(currentPoints, current) {
    const setup = chartSetup(
      rocChart,
      "Training ROC curve",
      "The chart shows true-positive rate on the vertical axis and false-positive rate on the horizontal axis as the decision threshold decreases."
    );
    rocChart.append(svgElement("line", {
      x1: setup.x(0), y1: setup.y(0), x2: setup.x(1), y2: setup.y(1),
      class: "threshold-metrics-reference"
    }));
    drawPath(
      rocChart, setup, currentPoints,
      point => point.fp / negativeCount,
      point => point.recall,
      "threshold-metrics-roc-curve",
      current.fp / negativeCount,
      current.recall
    );
    addAxes(rocChart, setup, "False-positive rate", "True-positive rate");
  }

  function drawPrecisionRecall(currentPoints, current) {
    const setup = chartSetup(
      prChart,
      "Training precision-recall curve",
      "The chart shows precision on the vertical axis and recall on the horizontal axis as the decision threshold decreases."
    );
    drawPath(
      prChart, setup, currentPoints,
      point => point.recall,
      point => point.precision,
      "threshold-metrics-pr-curve",
      current.recall,
      current.precision
    );
    addAxes(prChart, setup, "Recall", "Precision");
  }

  function drawF1(currentPoints, current) {
    const setup = chartSetup(
      f1Chart,
      "Training F1 score by decision threshold",
      "The chart shows F1 score on the vertical axis as the decision threshold decreases from 1 to 0."
    );
    drawPath(
      f1Chart, setup, currentPoints,
      point => point.threshold,
      point => point.f1,
      "threshold-metrics-f1-curve",
      current.threshold,
      current.f1
    );
    addAxes(f1Chart, setup, "Decision threshold τ", "F1 score");
  }

  function draw() {
    const current = points[pointIndex];
    const currentPoints = points.slice(0, pointIndex + 1);
    const falsePositiveRate = current.fp / negativeCount;

    drawRoc(currentPoints, current);
    drawPrecisionRecall(currentPoints, current);
    drawF1(currentPoints, current);
    thresholdValue.value = "τ = " + current.threshold.toFixed(2);
    thresholdValue.textContent = "τ = " + current.threshold.toFixed(2);
    status.textContent = "τ = " + current.threshold.toFixed(2)
      + " · precision = " + current.precision.toFixed(3)
      + " · recall / TPR = " + current.recall.toFixed(3)
      + " · FPR = " + falsePositiveRate.toFixed(3)
      + " · F1 = " + current.f1.toFixed(3)
      + " · TP = " + current.tp.toLocaleString()
      + " · FP = " + current.fp.toLocaleString()
      + " · FN = " + current.fn.toLocaleString();
  }

  function update(index) {
    pointIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(points.length - 1, index));
    slider.value = String(pointIndex);
    draw();
  }

  function stop() {
    running = false;
    if (animationFrame !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
    animationFrame = null;
    runButton.textContent = pointIndex >= points.length - 1
      ? "Replay all thresholds"
      : "Run all thresholds";
  }

  function animate(timestamp) {
    if (!running) return;
    if (timestamp - lastFrameTime >= 55) {
      update(pointIndex + 1);
      lastFrameTime = timestamp;
    }
    if (pointIndex >= points.length - 1) {
      stop();
      return;
    }
    animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  runButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (running) {
      stop();
      return;
    }
    if (pointIndex >= points.length - 1) update(0);
    running = true;
    runButton.textContent = "Pause";
    lastFrameTime = 0;
    animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  });

  stepButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    stop();
    update(pointIndex + 1);
  });

  resetButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    stop();
    update(0);
  });

  slider.addEventListener("input", () => {
    stop();
    update(Number.parseInt(slider.value, 10));
  });

  [rocChart, prChart, f1Chart].forEach(chart => new ResizeObserver(draw).observe(chart));
  update(0);
})();
</script>
